item.tib: gu ru pad 'byung gi rnam thar
item.coloph: zhes bka' gsang ba yongs 'dus zab don chen po'i rgyud kyi thog ma la/ b+hu ru'i rnam thar bstan 'byung yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ kun snang gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya bar/ bden tshig shis pa brjod pa'i don dam bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid gsum tshangs pa'i g.yul rtser sgrengs pa bya ba'i dge mtshan dang bcas te/ o rgyan thugs sras sprul sku sangs rgyas gling pas g.yung drung dpal gyi gdan sar/ bkra shis smin grol khrod du sbyar ba'i (bas) bstan pa phyogs bcu kun tu dar zhing rgyas la bkra shis yun ring gnas shing stong sum (gsum) 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i mchog tu dbang thob par gyur cig sarba karma bi dza ku wan+tu//
